description: Remove a task from a specific list (TIML). This does NOT delete the task, only the association with this list. The task must remain in at least one other list.

listId.description: ID of the list to remove the task from.

listName.description: Name of the list to remove the task from.

taskListName.description: Current list name of the task (helps resolve duplicate task names).

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: remove_task_from_list
